periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at an oblique angle approximately 45 degrees downward and away from the snout, clearly visible on the unobstructed left patch.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal elongation ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering from the ocular center toward the lower cheek, creating a teardrop-shaped profile.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior margin as it transitions to the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick band occupying approximately 30% of the visible torso length above the log surface.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular curvature with no visible flattening or irregularities at the superior edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant brownish-tan coloration of the fur across the ventral, abdominal, and lower extremity regions, contrasting with the white thoracic fur.
